_comment: Every third-party file the site loads, with where it came from and its SHA-256. The gate (check 5) recomputes every hash and fails on any file under vendor/ that is not listed, or any listed file that is missing or changed. Updates are a manual, reviewed PR with the hash change in the diff. No runtime fetch from any other origin, ever.

sg-tokens.css.purpose: The family design tokens, :host scoped for shadow-DOM components (step 4). assets/themes.css carries the same values as the Night theme, the default of four, for plain pages.

acorn.mjs.purpose: The JavaScript parser the review derivation runs at build time (review/tools/derive_js.mjs) to read the site's own scripts into the code graph. Never loaded by a page; node only.
